newsitem.title: USA: Newfield to buy Huffco, join China project.
newsitem.headline: Newfield to buy Huffco, join China project.

text.p: Newfield Exploration Co said Tuesday it would acquire Huffco International L.L., which will result in Newfield participating in the drilling of an exploratory well in China's Bohai Bay.
Newfield said the acquisition will be financed by the issuance of 275,000-300,000 shares, plus a small amount of cash. It said it would assume substantially all of Huffco's liabilities.

A Huffco subsidiary owns a 35 percent stake in a 415,000-acre production-sharing contract in Block 05/36, which is in 60 to 100 feet of water. An exploratory well will be drilled in the third quarter by operator Kerr-McGee Corp, Newfield said.

"While we are hopeful our entry into international exploration will provide longer-term growth for Newfield, we do not intend to slow down or de-emphasize our Gulf Coast activity," said Newfield Chief Executive Joe Foster. "We are working to acquire a number of important opportunities in the Gulf of Mexico and continuing to seek profitable onshore Louisiana properties."
As part of the Huffco deal, Newfield will acquire certain rights and data relating to offshore West Africa, a small technical staff, and an international data base, the company said.
